profileId.description: Wise profile ID that owns the quote.

sourceAmount.description: Amount in sourceCurrency. Provide either sourceAmount or targetAmount.

targetAmount.description: Amount in targetCurrency. Provide either sourceAmount or targetAmount.

payOut.description: Wise payout method such as BANK_TRANSFER or BALANCE.

preferredPayIn.description: Optional preferred pay-in method such as BALANCE.

targetAccount.description: Optional recipient account ID to attach to the quote.
